a.headline: Historical activity lacks outcome verification
a.read: October 20 dispatches progressed from control-plane and simulation work to relay, integration, and ring work. Completed statuses establish recorded endings, not verified behavior or merges.

actions.title: Check control-plane acceptance evidence
actions.why: Completed Dash work lacks supplied acceptance results, leaving control-plane usability unestablished.

actions.title: Define ring-to-relay acceptance check
actions.why: Completed ring and relay workers do not establish an end-to-end double-tap result.
actions.goal: NOOP ring double-tap to z0live working

actions.title: Reconcile interrupted integration work
actions.why: Interrupted integration workers leave completion evidence missing, preventing a defensible debt-reduction assessment.

b.headline: Dispatch continuity needs report-level confirmation
b.read: Batches mixed project labels, and two completed workers have heuristic resume links. Keyword owner flags suggest review candidates, not confirmed requests or accepted handoffs.

actions.title: Validate inferred resume handoffs
actions.why: Two resume links use goal-word matching; confirming transferred artifacts would clarify control-plane continuity.

actions.title: Triage keyword flags against reports
actions.why: Approval and review keywords alone cannot establish unresolved integration obligations.

actions.title: Assemble ring and relay evidence
actions.why: Separate ring and relay reports need a shared acceptance record before judging the complete interaction.
actions.goal: NOOP ring double-tap to z0live working

c.headline: Historical pace diverged across paid lanes
c.read: Claude showed 92% usage and 2.12 pace; Codex showed 7% and 0.47. Unpriced workers and seven-day tool errors limit cost and bottleneck conclusions.

actions.title: Refresh quotas before routing
actions.why: Historical lane imbalance suggests a routing review, but stale quota readings cannot justify present dispatch choices.

actions.title: Inspect bash and eval failures
actions.why: Seven-day bash and eval errors warrant transport and invocation checks before attributing integration delays to tests.

actions.title: Separate unpriced work from spend
actions.why: Null worker prices prevent complete cost accounting and cannot support zero-cost capacity assumptions.

d.headline: Choose evidence gates before further dispatch
d.read: The snapshot supports prioritizing acceptance evidence, interrupted-work reconciliation, and quota refresh. It does not establish device readiness, confirmed owner requests, or product success.

actions.title: Choose a control-plane acceptance gate
actions.why: Completed Dash workers and a historically running trace worker provide activity evidence, not a usability verdict.

actions.title: Request an authorized ring-check plan
actions.why: Ring workers completed, but device keywords do not prove access requirements or double-tap behavior.
actions.goal: NOOP ring double-tap to z0live working

actions.title: Prioritize unresolved integration artifacts
actions.why: Completed and interrupted integration work needs artifact reconciliation before choosing additional implementation.

timeline.read: This historical snapshot spans October 20 through early October 21; four workers were recorded running, without subsequent outcomes.
timeline.action: Compare dispatch order with final reports and acceptance records.

handoffs.read: Two completed workers have inferred resume links; mixed-label batches and keyword flags do not establish accepted handoffs.
handoffs.action: Confirm predecessor artifacts, successor scope, and report acknowledgments.

capacity.read: Historical Claude usage was 92% versus Codex 7%; quota age prevents present routing conclusions, and null costs remain unpriced.
capacity.action: Refresh both quotas and reset windows before proposing routing.

tools.read: Seven-day bash errors were 6/14 and eval 3/5; these do not establish test failures or individual run causes.
tools.action: Inspect error records to separate transport, invocation, and test outcomes.

decisions.read: Acceptance evidence and unresolved artifacts are missing; owner keywords and stall gaps remain heuristics, not confirmed requests or causes.
decisions.action: Choose acceptance gates and confirm actual blockers before assigning follow-up.

archive.read: Preserve this snapshot as historical evidence with quota timestamps, unpriced values, heuristic definitions, and status limitations.
archive.action: Store subsequent verification separately rather than rewriting historical statuses.
